changedFromV1.gate: v2 adds a label-free generator adequacy gate; GENERATOR_INADEQUATE_NO_INFERENCE if it fails
changedFromV1.harness: exclusive O_CREAT|O_EXCL marker, failure record, no-overwrite publication, structured scope
changedFromV1.null: v1 circular rotation (independence of C from the calendar) -> v2 conditional randomization test: 999 whole flag paths drawn from G(C_t | gap_t, vol_t, C_t-1, C_t-2), M2 refitted on each
changedFromV1.verdict: EXPLORATORY_CONDITIONAL_INFORMATION_SUPPORT iff adequacy AND dBrier > 0 AND CRT p <= 0.05 AND dBrier > 0 under every single-episode exclusion (evaluation side, no refit)

decisionRule:
1. the real credit-flag generator is ADEQUATE on the label-free checks, and
      2. in every null environment S0-S5 the gated v2 support-verdict rate has a Clopper-Pearson 95% lower bound
         <= 0.05 and a point estimate <= 0.075, and
      3. in every null environment S0-S5 the CRT rejection rate among worlds whose generator passed the same
         adequacy gate satisfies the same two bounds.
    otherwise NOT_READY_FOR_INFERENTIAL_STAGE_3.

generator.form: logistic: intercept, C_t-1, C_t-2, gap200_t, vol63_t (standardised), ridge 1.0, fitted on all 337 defined months, all FAST states, no label

hypothesis.claimTested: A (conditional information): given the month-end price-feature path, the real-time credit flag path carries information about the 126-session first -15% passage labels
hypothesis.notTested: B (whether this particular M2 forecasts better than this particular M1) is reported as dBrier but is not what the p-value refers to; the p-value is valid for H0 whatever M1's form
hypothesis.nullHypothesis: H0: the credit-flag path, given the price-feature path, follows the generator law G and is independent of the labels
